purpose: Resolve and combine every locked MinerU target-page artifact for a task so cross-page tasks use the same evidence contract as single-page tasks.
allowed_changes: Resolve target artifacts exclusively from the frozen P1 MinerU target registry.
Verify registry document id, document hash, task membership, requested page coverage, run-record hash, source hash, and parser success before loading evidence.
Combine page-local MinerU handles in ascending PDF-page order.
Record every content-list and run-record hash in the task context manifest.
prohibited_changes: No task, question, target-page, source-document, intervention, model-digest, or reference-answer changes.
No reference answer may enter the inference request.
No post-inference evidence repair, page substitution, semantic repair, or output rewriting.
No fallback to Poppler line text when a MinerU artifact is absent or invalid.
